title: Spatial canvas leaves
description: The leaf types of a spatial canvas: colour, geometry, the sides and arrowheads of an edge, and how edges are routed.

CanvasColorPreset.description: One of the six numbered preset colours of JSON Canvas 1.0.

CanvasColorHex.x-wb-message: must be a preset "1"–"6" or a 6-digit hex color such as "#1a2b3c"

CanvasColor.description: A canvas colour: a numbered preset or a 6-digit hex string (JSON Canvas 1.0).

NodePosition.description: A coordinate on the canvas: a finite real, where JSON Canvas 1.0 has integer pixels.

NodeSize.description: The width or height of a node: a finite real number that is not negative. Zero is valid.

x.description: Distance from the canvas origin along x.

y.description: Distance from the canvas origin along y.

Bends.description: Points to draw a line through, in order; at most 64, since more is a defect, not a drawing.

EdgeSide.description: A side of a node an edge may attach to.

Arrowhead.description: The arrowhead drawn at one end of an edge.

EdgeRoutingStyle.description: How an edge gets from one endpoint to the other once the router must step around something.

LineJumps.description: Whether a small arc is drawn where one edge crosses another.

EdgeRouting.description: The resolved answer to how edges are drawn; never a stored shape.

style.description: How an edge steps around an obstacle.

lineJumps.description: Whether crossings are drawn with an arc.
